items.title: Bob Wilber interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 22, 1998
items.q: When they called Paul Whiteman the “King of Jazz” in the ‘20s, that was a platitude.

ctx.x: No. When they called Paul Whiteman the “King of Jazz” in the ‘20s, that was a platitude. But Benny Goodman was the “King of Swing.” He was certainly my first great influence.
When you got to be old enough to start gigging professionally then, it was more of a small ensemble opportunity?
